title: Sage ai_profile record
description: A ai_profile record (AIProfileRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another ai_profile record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

selector.description: How it picks a schedule; empty = "rules" with rules, else "default". (string, default "")

when+.description: Adds to "when": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

when-.description: Removes these from "when" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

unless.description: Conditions none of which may hold. (List<string>)

unless+.description: Adds to "unless": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

unless-.description: Removes these from "unless" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

schedule.description: The schedule this rule runs. Names a ai_schedule record. (RecordRef<AIScheduleRecord>)

rules+.description: Adds to "rules": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

when+.description: Adds to "when": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

when-.description: Removes these from "when" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

unless-.description: Removes these from "unless" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

unless-.description: Removes these from "unless" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

routine.description: Its daily routine; an entity's own `routine` part wins over it. Names a routine record. (RecordRef<RoutineRecord>)

hearing.description: How far it hears, times a noise's radius; 0 = deaf. Range: 0 to 2. (float, default 1)

occludedHearing.description: What a wall between it and a noise leaves of its hearing. Range: 0 to 1. (float, default 0.5)

interestSeconds.description: How long something it heard stays worth investigating. Unit: s. At least 0. (float, default 15)
